blocked_actor.evidence: The exact Clinical Lead role filter returned no users in the signed-in System Users register. Static review confirmed the dedicated role and lead permissions exist, but the current/default user population omits it. No account was created and no broader role was treated as an equivalent substitute.
blocked_actor.minimum_honest_closure: Provide a dedicated current Clinical/Medication Lead demo user with documented site/global scope; creating or re-roling an account was outside this read-only audit.
